text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic photographic studio character asset, natural skin pores and fine individual hair, realistic cotton and knit detail. Pure white seamless background, bright soft frontal daylight balanced fill, low shadows, realistic 50mm lens perspective, no plastic skin, no illustration or 3D, no text or labels or logos.  One original fictional adult man. White European man with airy ash-brown side-part waves, quiet introspective charm, plain charcoal tee. Facial design: heart-shaped face with shorter midface and broad cheeks, rounded small chin, fine curved brows, warm amber eyes, broad straight nose, narrower mouth with a full upper lip. Light neutral skin, clean-shaven. Charcoal cotton tee, olive straight chinos, dark brown suede low-top sneakers. Lean 187cm build. Exactly three equally spaced full-body views of ONE SAME person in one horizontal row: strict FRONT at left, strict 90-degree SIDE profile facing image-left in center, strict 180-degree BACK at right. Consistent identity, clothing, hairstyle, shoes and 8.5-head tall long-limbed anatomy. Relaxed straight upright stance arms by sides. Every figure fully visible from hair to soles with margin, identical height, same baseline. Pure white ground, narrow white gutters, landscape 3:2. No text. Tall lean athletic male fashion-model anatomy with approximately 8.5 anatomical head lengths from skull crown to bare-foot soles. Head excluding hair volume is about 11.8% of total standing height. Long legs and arms, proportionate shoulders and waist, normal neck length, natural muscle definition. Do not elongate the face or neck or use shoe soles to fake height. Straight camera with no foreshortening.
